tierA_monitoring.description: Fixed source list checked on a schedule. High precision, low recall by design. A hit here means an existing pattern changed or a trusted source explicitly announced something new.

tierA_monitoring.notes: Add practitioner blogs here as you find ones worth trusting. Each addition should include an id, title, url, and checkMethod so the monitoring pipeline stays mechanical rather than needing judgment calls about what changed.

tierB_discovery.description: Broader, noisier sweep. Purpose is to find named patterns NOT already represented in data/manifest.json's tab list. A finding only becomes a candidate if it clears the corroboration rule in scripts/discovery-pipeline docs (>=2 independent, non-citing sources naming it consistently, and it is not just a renamed existing tab).
seedQueries: agent tool calling cost reduction pattern
LLM agent memory architecture pattern name
tierB_discovery.tripwireNote: Aggregator hits are a signal to look closer, never evidence on their own. Do not count a tripwire hit toward the >=2-source corroboration requirement.
